title: fix(runtime, plugin-sharing): a share link's resolve answer describes the fields it returns, so the shared-record page can show authored labels
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X5AGM4y97vjVvqa9btSXiHi)_

Fixes #26991

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：分享链接的解析接口（`GET /api/v1/share-links/TOKEN/resolve`）在原有的 `record` / `link` / `redactFields` 之外，多返回一个 `fields`：只描述这条记录实际下发的字段，每个字段给出作者写的标签、类型、下拉选项的标签与颜色、货币设置、查找字段指向的对象和显示字段。两个出口（plugin-sharing 路由与 runtime 调度器）都经同一个 `buildShareLinkResolveAnswer`（`@objectstack/types`）生成答案。
- **为什么改**：打开分享链接的访客通常未登录，读不到对象元数据（`/meta/object` 对匿名返回 401），所以分享页只能把字段键名转成标题显示，作者写的中文标签、选项名、货币和查找名都显示不出来。
- **风险与回滚**：低。只新增一个响应键，原有三个键不变；被脱敏的字段在 `record` 和 `fields` 里都不出现，记录没下发的字段（如 `internal`）也不出现，不会多暴露对象的其它字段；`/meta` 的匿名拒绝不动。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/types/src/share-link-resolve-answer.ts`（`projectSharedRecordFields` 的边界：只看记录里的键）；`packages/runtime/src/domains/share-links.ts` 与 `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/share-link-routes.ts` 的 resolve 出口。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/share-links-field-projection.test.ts`，预期 12/12 通过（两个出口各 5 条，外加两条两出口答案相等）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`GET /api/v1/share-links/TOKEN/resolve` answered `{ record, link, redactFields }` on both mounts. It now answers `{ record, link, redactFields, fields }`, built once by `buildShareLinkResolveAnswer` in `@objectstack/types` for both the plugin-sharing routes (`registerShareLinkRoutes`) and the runtime dispatcher's `/share-links` domain.

`fields` is keyed by field name. Each entry holds only what a read-only renderer needs:

| Key | When present |
|---|---|
| `label`, `type` | as the object schema holds them (authored labels; the resolve read path has no caller-locale seam, and none is built) |
| `options` | a field declaring options: each option's `value`, `label`, `color` (never `default` or visibility rules) |
| `multiple` | `true` only |
| `currencyConfig` | `currencyMode`, `defaultCurrency` |
| `reference`, `displayField` | a lookup's target object and authored display field |

- **The boundary.** A field is projected only when the served record carries its key after redaction AND the shared object declares it. So a redacted field is absent from both `record` and `fields`, a field the record read never returns (`internal: true`) is absent from both, and no other field of the object is described. The meta door's anonymous refusal (`GET /meta/object/NAME` answers 401) is unchanged; nothing new reads object metadata for an anonymous caller beyond what the served record's own keys already name.
- **Lookups.** Measured: the record read (`engine.find(object, { where: { id }, limit: 1 })` under a system context) expands nothing, so a lookup's value is its stored id. The projection names `reference` and the authored `displayField`; no second read expands names.
- **System columns.** The served record carries the registry-injected columns (`created_at`, `updated_at`, `organization_id`, `created_by`, `updated_by`, `owner_id`, `owning_business_unit_id`, `queue`), and the projection describes them like any other served key (e.g. `owner_id` → `{ label: 'Owner', type: 'lookup', reference: 'sys_user' }`). Measured from a real resolve in the new test's harness.

### Placement of the one helper

`@objectstack/types`, as `share-link-resolve-answer.ts` beside `share-password-header.ts`. `@objectstack/plugin-sharing` is a dev dependency of `@objectstack/runtime`, so the plugin cannot be the home; both packages already depend on `@objectstack/types` (and on `@objectstack/spec`, which may hold no runtime logic), so the helper adds no dependency edge. This is the same placement and reasoning the shared password-header reading already uses.

The two `applyRedaction` copies are folded into it as `redactSharedRecord`: the plugin's copy (it also stripped each object of a top-level array). Redaction is unchanged for every input either mount passes: both pass the one row object they read, where the two copies were identical.

### Unchanged

The existing three keys and their values; refusal arms and their order; response headers; the `/messages` route; the console's fold (`ui/apps/console/src/pages/shared-record-shape.ts` reads `record`, `link`, `redactFields` off `WireResolvedShare` and ignores any other key, so the additive `fields` does not change what it parses). No `packages/spec` schema: the resolve answer is not spec-declared today, and this PR does not declare it. No `ui/**` change: the console reading `fields` is the follow-up the card names.

## Tests

- `runtime` `src/domains/share-links-field-projection.test.ts` (new, 12): both mounts' production entries over one real `ObjectQL` + `driver-sql` (better-sqlite3) + `ShareLinkService`, on an object with an authored label, a select with option labels and a colour, a fixed-currency field, a lookup with `displayField`, a per-link redacted field and an `internal` field. Per mount: `fields` keys equal the record's keys that the object declares; the redacted field is in neither; control: with no redaction it is in both; the `internal` field is in neither; the label/type/options/currency/lookup entries are exact and the lookup's value is the stored id. Parity: for each link, the two mounts' `data` are equal.
- `types` `src/share-link-resolve-answer.test.ts` (new, 7): the boundary, the display-only keys, the nine link columns (never the hash, allowlist or creator), an unreadable schema projects nothing, a redacted key is skipped even if still present, `redactSharedRecord` shapes.
- `plugin-sharing` `share-link-envelope.conformance.test.ts`: the resolve key-set pin now names `fields`.
- `runtime` `domain-handler-registry.test.ts`: the extracted share-links domain's engine double answers `getSchema` (the route reads it off the same engine the refusal probe already reads it from) and the case asserts the redacted key is absent from `fields`.

<details><summary>Red first, ablation</summary>

- Red, at `d17dd70e` (the new test on `origin/main` `cbb3a1a1` code): `Tests 10 failed | 2 passed (12)`; every per-mount case failed on the absent `fields` (`the answer carries a field projection: expected undefined to be type of 'object'`); the two parity cases passed, both mounts lacking the key alike.
- Green at `653c867a`: `Tests 12 passed (12)`.
- Ablation (committed fix, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`): `for (const key of Object.keys(record)) {` → `for (const key of Object.keys(declared)) {` (project the object's whole field map). Anchor 1 → 0, blob `7c0a9303886d` → `19df7f482a58`; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/types build`; `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs @objectstack/types 'Object.keys(declared)'` hit `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.mjs`. Run: `Tests 4 failed | 8 passed (12)`: "projects exactly the served record keys…" and "a field the record read never returns (internal)…" on both mounts. Restore: `git checkout HEAD --`, `git diff HEAD` empty, hash equals the HEAD blob, rebuild, preflight `--absent` exit 0 with the whole tree clean, run `Tests 12 passed (12)`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `fields` labels are authored, untranslated: the resolve path has no caller-locale seam today. A localized projection would be a new channel for the anonymous caller, which the dispatch excluded.
- A `dynamic` currency field displays in the tenant default currency (`localization.currency`), which an anonymous page cannot read; the projection carries `currencyConfig` as declared and nothing more.
- The console still humanizes keys until its follow-up reads `fields` (`SharedRecordFields.tsx`, `shared-record-shape.ts`); its comments describing the answer as `{ record, link, redactFields }` move with that follow-up.
